name: California Pre-Register to Vote (ages 16 and 17)
what_you_do: Sign up early so you are on the voter list the day you turn 18. Pairs well with the SF elections ambassador program.
who_can_apply: California residents ages 16 and 17 who are US citizens and not in prison for a felony or ruled mentally unable to vote by a court.
how_to_apply: Fill in the online form at registertovote.ca.gov (linked from the Secretary of State page).
notes: Not a job or internship, but a real civic step. Your registration becomes active when you turn 18. Citizenship is required.
